data.title: Industrial Software Engineer
data.summary: Build operational software that operators actually use, from data model to interface and deployment.
data.description: You will work across the stack on production portals, quality workflows, and integration services. The role suits an engineer who cares about domain modelling and interface clarity as much as framework choice, and who is willing to spend time on the plant floor.
responsibilities: Model operational domains and design APIs with the team.
Build Vue and Laravel applications for production and quality teams.
Integrate OT data sources with clear contracts and observability.
Test with operators and iterate on real shift constraints.
Contribute to deployment, monitoring, and support routines.
requirements: Strong TypeScript and either Laravel or a comparable backend framework.
Experience with SQL, APIs, and automated testing.
Interest in industrial operations and human factors.
